versions.changelog:
Initial release of cn-content-factory:

- Launches a one-stop Chinese content creation tool for platforms like 小红书, 公众号, 抖音, and 知乎
- Enables hot topic ideation, viral title generation, and multi-platform content adaptation
- Includes "de-AI" polishing, platform-specific SEO optimization, and content quality safeguards
- Supports bulk topic generation and content batch production
- Designed for self-media creators, e-commerce sellers, MCNs, and freelance writers
